The SMARTS pattern specifies a neutral, three- or four-coordinate Pd(0) complex, so no separate palladium-ligand dissociation or reduction is required. The coupling proceeds through copper activation of the organometallic partner, oxidative addition of the electrophile to Pd(0), transmetalation of the organic group from copper to palladium, and reductive elimination to form the new C–C bond and regenerate Pd(0). Neutralization is not a required stage for this ligand-protected Pd(0) system.
